description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claim to land parcel in Polgahaanga, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District Cad. Map No. 320240 and 07 other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act, dealing specifically with land ownership, possession, and interest determinations. The content focuses on land registration, cadastral maps, and title settlement processes across multiple districts, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
